scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a bearded king seated on a gold throne, extending his hand toward a veiled queen in teal and ivory. scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined audience connects Esther's receipt of Haman's estate with Mordecai's admission before the king after she disclosed their relationship. The closed scroll is an illustrative symbol of the estate transfer, not an object specified by the verse. Faces, clothing and Persian-inspired architecture are imaginative conventions. Haman is absent.
